competitors.name: Motor City Pizza Co. / Champion Foods
competitors.action: Champion Foods recalled certain Motor City Pizza Co. 5 Cheese Bread single and 2-pack SKUs after California Dairies milk powder used in a seasoning blend raised salmonella contamination concerns, creating a fresh food-safety and retailer-trust issue across major national grocery accounts.

competitors.name: Palermo's / Connie's
competitors.action: Palermo Villa launched a premium Connie's wood-fired frozen pizza line with 24-hour slowly fermented dough, all-natural toppings, and a $10.99 suggested retail price, rolling into select Midwest retailers and pushing harder into premium texture-led frozen pizza.

competitors.name: Yough / Founders Row / Target
competitors.action: Yough secured a strategic investment from Founders Row as its Greek-yogurt-crust frozen pizzas expanded into nearly 2,000 Target stores nationwide, bringing a high-protein, cleaner-label challenger into mainstream mass retail at $9.99 per pie.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza competition is splitting between premium craft cues and functional nutrition claims
trends.magnitude: Palermo's is leaning into wood-fired fermentation and Yough is leaning into 40-50g protein Greek-yogurt crusts at national Target scale
trends.context: The category is not converging on one winning lane. Premium texture/story and measurable nutrition are both getting shelf space, which means Real Dough still needs a sharper ownable sourdough craft story instead of generic premium positioning.

trends.topic: Food-safety risk is still a live category vulnerability in frozen pizza and adjacent bread products
trends.magnitude: Motor City Pizza Co. recall reached major national retailers after a contaminated dairy ingredient entered the seasoning supply chain
trends.context: Operational credibility matters as much as branding. A quality event can instantly undercut shelf trust across multiple retailers, which makes manufacturing discipline a competitive advantage, not just a back-end requirement.

breaking.headline: This week's strongest frozen-pizza signals are premium texture, protein positioning, and safety execution
breaking.impact: Palermo's is upgrading the premium frozen playbook, Yough is proving functional frozen pizza can land in mass retail, and the Motor City recall is a reminder that one supplier issue can become a national trust problem fast.
